name: Botany
overview: Scripture reveals God's orderly design in the vegetable kingdom, where natural laws govern growth and beauty, as seen in the lilies of the field that neither toil nor spin, yet surpass even Solomon's glory in array. The botanical imagery underscores spiritual truths: just as a tree is known by its fruit, so are people recognized by their deeds, emphasizing that good cannot come from evil and vice versa. This teaches the principle that sowing sparingly results in a limited harvest, encouraging faithful and generous stewardship in all areas of life.
